applicability: Bonferroni multiple-comparisons correction checking whether a claimed significant p-value survives correction for the declared number of hypotheses tested
assumptions: the declared number of hypotheses tested reflects the true number of comparisons made
Bonferroni's conservative family-wise error control is the appropriate standard
uncertainty: Standard textbook multiple-testing correction (Bonferroni 1936); hand-verified before use (alpha=0.05,n=1 -> 0.05; alpha=0.05,n=20 -> 0.0025).
limits_policy: A p-value that fails the adjusted threshold is flagged as not significant after correction rather than accepted.
